provenance.solver/bed_temperature_bracket: T_amb+10 K; fallback [T_amb+0.5 K, T_amb+10 K] iff the residual at T_amb+10 K is negative

heater_efficiency.rationale: The five data sets of the partner use 70, 80 and 90 %; the range spans them. A direct-fired gas heater rarely lies below 70 %; nominal (data set 5) is the lower end.
heater_efficiency.question: heater

dt_min_k.rationale: Minimum approach per counter-current exchanger, main convention 10 K (docs/11 section 11); 5 K (large, expensive exchangers) to 20 K (compact ones) as the usual design band of liquid-coupled gas exchangers. Stands for the exchanger characteristic (area, UA), which is not known.
dt_min_k.question: exchanger

heat_loss_ua_w_per_k.rationale: The partner model has no heat loss (0). Upper end: about 5 % of the heater duty of data set 5 (0.4 kW at the 158 degC exhaust, 138 K above ambient). Insulation of the plant unknown.
heat_loss_ua_w_per_k.question: heat_loss

equilibrium_moisture_kg_per_kg.rationale: Product moisture of the dryer block. From the partner sheet (2 g/kg) to the lab level of the GAB anchor (0.030 kg/kg at 50 % RH, 62 degC; Befund 34). No sorption measurement of the material exists.
equilibrium_moisture_kg_per_kg.question: isotherm

cp_vapour_j_per_kg_k.rationale: Repository value 1.86 against the partner's 1.906 kJ/(kg K) (docs/11 12.7 item 8).
cp_vapour_j_per_kg_k.question: cp_vapour

ambient_temperature_celsius.rationale: Weather box of the lab line (DisturbanceRange), also the fresh-gas temperature.

ambient_relative_humidity.rationale: Weather box of the lab line (DisturbanceRange); converted with IAPWS-IF97 at 1 atm.

spray_kg_per_h.rationale: Throughput +-20 % (stress band of docs/24; the observed amplitude +-1.5 % is far smaller). Operating envelope, not running operation (decision 2026-10-22).

solid_fraction.rationale: Relative +-20 % (stress band as for P2; the observed relative amplitude is +-7.7 %).

gab_monolayer_moisture_kg_per_kg.rationale: x0.8-1.2, the GAB band of the robustness variant of docs/24 (placeholder).
gab_monolayer_moisture_kg_per_kg.question: isotherm

gab_c_constant_at_reference_temperature.rationale: x0.5-2 log-uniform, as in docs/24 (the C constant spans orders of magnitude).
gab_c_constant_at_reference_temperature.question: isotherm

gab_k_constant_at_reference_temperature.rationale: 0.70-0.80 as in docs/24 (K < 1 required; typical of granular solids).
gab_k_constant_at_reference_temperature.question: isotherm

gab_c_enthalpy_j_per_mol.rationale: x0.5-1.5, as in docs/24 (temperature dependence of the isotherm unknown).
gab_c_enthalpy_j_per_mol.question: isotherm

max_saturation_degree.rationale: nu_max; literature band 0.4-0.8 for fluidised beds (comment of the process config).
max_saturation_degree.question: drying_kinetics

critical_moisture_kg_per_kg.rationale: Lab level 0.200. Lower end at the quality limit 0.15 (below it the limit would lie in the constant-rate period); upper end near the wettest lab measurement (0.29 kg/kg dry, greybox_lab_moisture.yaml). Draws below the isotherm maximum are counted as invalid.
critical_moisture_kg_per_kg.question: drying_kinetics

heat_loss_ua_w_per_k.rationale: Placeholder 2 W/K ("insulated lab plant assumed"); 0 (adiabatic) to twice.
heat_loss_ua_w_per_k.question: heat_loss

gas_heater_efficiency.rationale: Gas-fired heater of the CO2 booking (placeholder 0.80, Befund 60); 0.70-0.90 as the partner data sets. Enters only the CO2 outputs: the RTO objective is the model's total power (electric heater 0.98, as in docs/24), so (b)-(d) cannot depend on it (built-in check).
gas_heater_efficiency.question: heater

cp_vapour_j_per_kg_k.rationale: Repository value 1.86 against the partner's 1.906 kJ/(kg K).
cp_vapour_j_per_kg_k.question: cp_vapour

ambient_temperature_celsius.rationale: Weather box of the lab line (DisturbanceRange).

ambient_relative_humidity.rationale: Weather box of the lab line (DisturbanceRange).

spray_rate_kg_per_h.rationale: Throughput +-20 % (stress band of docs/24; observed +-1.5 %). Operating envelope, not running operation.

suspension_solid_fraction.rationale: DisturbanceRange of the lab line = stress band of docs/24 (observed: 0.30 +- 7.7 %).

questions.isotherm: Lab measurement: sorption isotherm of the material at 2-3 temperatures (GAB fit); Befund 34
questions.drying_kinetics: Lab measurement: drying curve (critical moisture) and exhaust humidity of the lab line (nu_max)
questions.heater: Application partner: type and efficiency of the air heater (burner data, gas meter)
questions.exchanger: Application partner / integration partner: exchanger design (area, UA or guaranteed approach)
questions.heat_loss: Application partner: insulation and wall temperatures of dryer and ducts (or a heat balance)
questions.cp_vapour: Application partner: source of cp_vapour 1.906 (docs/11 12.7 item 8; literature suffices)

correlations: not modelled: all inputs independent and uniform (see the YAML)
